\caption{Cumulative-return differences from market-capitalization weighting, in percentage points. Blue denotes higher terminal wealth and red lower wealth on a common symmetric scale. Rows follow methodological groups; the bold S\&P 500 label highlights the primary price benchmark, not significance. Headings give observed dates and monthly counts. Strategies include 20-basis-point round-trip costs; market indices are uncosted. S\&P 500 excludes dividends, whereas CRSP and FF include them. Unequal regime lengths limit comparisons across columns; colors do not indicate significance.}
\label{fig:regime_heatmap}
\end{figure*}
